appDesc: Your logbook of cars spotted on the street, with rarities, the Marcadex and spec sheets.
install: Install the Logbook on your phone to open it like an app.
plateHint: drag your finger over each number plate or person's face and it gets blurred.
plateAria: Photo of the car. Drag over a number plate to cover it.
needName: Write at least the make or the model.
photoFail: The photo wasn't saved, but the car was.
backupText: Everything you save stays on this phone only. Nobody else sees your cars or your photos. Make a backup every now and then so you don't lose anything if you change phones or clear your browser.
safetyText: Before saving a photo, cover the number plates and people's faces. Only take photos in public places and don't touch other people's cars.
brandLocked: You haven't caught this brand yet. Catch one of its cars to unlock its profile and history.
histLocked: Locked. Catch a car from this brand to read it.
modelHint: The number on each model is how rare it is on the street, from 1 to 10. Tap a model to see its versions.
noSpec: There's no spec sheet for this model yet.
noVersions: This model has no special versions on the list.
notCaughtModel: You haven't caught this model yet.
emptyText: Tap “Add car” and put in your first one.
removeSure: Are you sure? Tap again to remove
saved: Backup saved with {n} cars. It's in your downloads folder.
exportFail: Couldn't make the backup. Try again.
notBackup: That file isn't a Logbook backup.
importInfo: This backup has {a} Street cars and {b} Show cars. The cars you already have stay; the ones in the backup are added.

welcomeTitle: Welcome to the Car Spotter's Logbook!
welcomeText: Catch cars on the street, level up and complete the Marcadex.
nickHint: Use a nickname, not your real name. It's what your friends will see.
friendsSub: Share your logbook with friends and see their cars.
shareText: Creates a file with your cars to send to a friend, for example on WhatsApp. Where you saw each car is not included.
shareSaved: File created. Send it to your friend.
addFriendText: Open the file a friend sent you here.
notShare: That file isn't a shared logbook.
ownFile: That file is your own logbook.
friendAdded: {n} has been added to your friends!
noFriendsText: Ask a friend to send you their logbook and open it here.
safetyFriends: Only share with friends you know in real life.
friendNoCars: No cars in this logbook yet.
meSub: Your level, your achievements, challenges and your collection's stats.
ch_ctry: Catch a car from a brand from {c}

ach_leg_d: Catch a Legendary (8) car or better on the street.
ach_myth_d: Catch a Mythic (9) car or better on the street.
ach_uni_d: Catch a Unicorn (10) on the street.
ach_bus_d: Catch a football club's team bus on the move.
ach_speed_d: Catch a car that goes over 300 km/h.
ach_hp_d: Catch a car with more than 500 hp.

ach_expo1_d: Add your first car to Shows.
noStats: Collect some cars to see your stats.
mapText: The places where you caught cars. The map and locations stay on your phone only and are never included in the files you share.
mapEmpty: No cars with a location yet. When you add a car, turn on “Save where I am”.
mapPreview: The map only works in the app installed on your phone.
mapFail: Couldn't load the map. It needs an internet connection.
useGps: Save where I am (just for your map)
gpsFail: Couldn't find where you are. The car was saved without a location.
tut1_d: See a cool car? Tap “Take photo” or pick it from the “Gallery”. You can also share a photo from Google Photos straight to the app. The photo's date is filled in for you.
tut2_d: Before saving, drag your finger over number plates and people's faces. Then type the brand and model: the app suggests the rarity and tells you if it's a new car for you.
tut3_d: From Common (1) to Unicorn (10): the rarer, the more points. Museums, shows, races and festivals go in the “Shows” logbook, which has a stricter scale.
tut4_d: 124 brands and over 1000 models, with history and spec sheets: horsepower, top speed, 0–100 and value. On a model you don't have yet, tap “Want to catch” to add it to your wishlist.
tut5_d: Tap a car to see its card up close. Put your best ones in the Showcase, share the card as an image, or tap “Compare” to put it against any car in the Marcadex.
rules: Rules: only take photos in public places, don't touch other people's cars and respect people.
haveModel: You already have {n} car of this model.
You already have {n} cars of this model.
vitrineEmpty: Open a card and tap ⭐ to put it here.
backupNever: You haven't made a backup of your {n} cars yet. If you lose your phone, you lose your logbook.
backupOld: You haven't made a backup in {d} days.
streakNone: Catch a car today to start a streak!
ach_streak3_d: Catch cars 3 days in a row.
ach_streak7_d: Catch cars 7 days in a row.
shareCardPreview: Sharing only works in the installed app.
dupWarn: ⚠️ You already caught a {m} today. Is it the same car?
updateReady: There's a new version of the app!
quizSub: 10 questions about brands and cars. Your first round each day earns XP.
quizNoXp: You've already earned quiz XP today. Come back tomorrow for more!
q_rarity: Which of these is rarer to spot on the street?
setsSub: Collect every car in a set to earn {n} XP.
brandOfDayMiss: You haven't got this brand yet. Keep your eyes peeled!
ach_quiz10_d: Get 10 out of 10 in the quiz.
duelSub: Your cards against the computer's. Pick your card's strongest stat: whoever has the higher value wins the round.
duelNeed: You need at least 5 cards with a spec sheet to play. Keep catching cars!
duelNoXp: You've already earned duel XP today.
wishEmpty: In the Marcadex, open a model and tap “Want to catch” to add it here.
wishGot: You caught one from your wish list: {m}!
wishSub: The cars you want to find. Catch one and you get {n} XP.
sharedInText: Now type the brand and model.
sessHint: Going car hunting? Turn this on and see a summary at the end.
sessStarted: Every car you add counts for this trip.
tripEmptyText: It happens to the best. Next time!
tripsSub: Tap “Start a spotting trip” in the logbook when you go car hunting.
cmpPickText: Which car do you want to compare the {c} with?
cmpMineNone: You have no other cars with a spec sheet.
cmpDexHint: Type a name to search any car in the Marcadex (e.g. Bugatti).
wrapSub: Your spotting year as stories. At the end you can save an image.
printText: Print your logbook or save it as a PDF (choose “Save as PDF” on the print screen).
ach_trip1_d: Finish a trip with 3 or more cars.
tut6_d: Going car hunting? Tap “Start a spotting trip”. The app counts the time, cars and points and shows a summary when you finish.
tut7_d: In the Marcadex and on your Player page you'll find the Car quiz, the Card duel against the computer and themed sets to complete. Everything gives XP.
tut8_d: Earn XP to level up, complete daily and weekly challenges, keep your day streak and unlock achievements. At the end of the year, watch your Year in review.
tut9_d: In “Friends” you share a file with your cars and add your friends' files to see the ranking. Where you saw the cars is never shared.
tut10_d: Your cars live only on your phone. Tap “Save backup” now and then so you never lose anything. You can see this tutorial again in Player → “How it works”.
tutNew: What's new! See everything the app can do.
